about: One entry per self-improvement run (scripts: ops/improvement-playbook.md). status: watching -> helped | no clear effect | hurt | reverted; no-op runs are logged too.

entries.title: Added static A-Z link lists to companies.html and judges.html
entries.why: site_audit.py (ops/metrics/audit.json, 2026-10-09 snapshot) found 92 orphan root pages. 76 of them were the company-*.html and judge-*.html profile pages, which companies.html and judges.html only ever link to from JavaScript-built cards, invisible to site_audit and to any crawler that doesn't execute JS. This was backlog item 1, ranked top because it was the audit's largest single finding category.

entries.title: Cleared the remaining 16 orphan root pages (state guides, author bio, newsletter, handbook redirect)
entries.why: site_audit.py (--print, re-run live this session) showed orphanPages still at 16 after imp-001: the 13 state-guide deep-dive pages, only linked from state-guides.html's JS-built state picker (same shape as imp-001's company/judge pages); author-jeff-novel.html and newsletter.html, with zero static inbound links anywhere on the site; and handbook.html, a pure client-side redirect stub to eviction-guide.html that a crawler would never follow in. This was backlog item 2.
